entities.summary: Leonhard Christoph Sturm (b. 1669-11-05, Altdorf bei Nürnberg) was a religious figure or clergy of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Altdorf bei Nürnberg. Known in the fields of architects & engineers.
